result.summary: The page is mostly well-designed, but one data formatting bug is visible: the delivery fee for 'Smash Bros Burgers' shows as '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed numeric parse/render. Other partially visible elements (carousel clipping at the right edge, card cut off at the bottom) are expected behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The delivery fee under 'Smash Bros Burgers' renders as '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid price (e.g. '€1.50 delivery' or 'Free delivery'), indicating a broken value from data or a failed number formatting step.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data/formatting pipeline so the delivery fee is a valid number; add a fallback (e.g. hide the fee line or show 'Free delivery'/'—') when the value is missing or non-numeric so 'NaN' is never displayed to users.
